_comment: Input for script/ha_lite_closure.py.
'roots' are the anchors the retained runtime is defined by. They mirror the
job matrices in .github/workflows/ha-lite-ci.yml: what CI protects is what
ha-lite promises to keep working.
'device_class_semantics' roots are the components that define the named
trigger and condition vocabulary over entity device classes (motion.detected,
door.opened, air_quality.smoke_detected). binary_sensor and sensor ship no
trigger.py or condition.py of their own, so these components are the only
semantic layer over them. See docs/adr/0012.
'accepted_transitive' records every domain the closure pulls in that is not
itself a root, with a reviewed reason. A domain reaching the closure without
an entry here fails the check, so new coupling from retained code into an
unreviewed component cannot land silently.
status values:
retained       - part of the runtime; expected to stay
adapter        - coupling lives in a removable platform-adapter file, so
the target leaves with that file rather than on its own
patch_required - genuine coupling that needs a decoupling change first
'cross_cutting_platforms' are platform files the runtime loads BY NAME via
async_get_platform, never by import, and dispatches to generically. The
edge graph cannot see them, so deleting a provider removes a capability
without breaking an import. They do not grow the closure -- the runtime
requires no particular provider -- but providers outside it are reported
as 'capability at risk'.
Self-scoped platforms are deliberately absent: config_flow, diagnostics,
application_credentials and config only extend their own integration, so
they leave with it and warning about them would be noise.

backup.reason: Reached only through hassio. Leaves with the hassio patch unless headless backup semantics keep it.

device_automation.reason: Entity domains ship device_action.py/device_trigger.py adapters for Home Assistant device automation.

device_tracker.reason: DHCP discovery watches device_tracker registrations from its own __init__, so this is runtime coupling rather than an adapter file.

file_upload.reason: MQTT certificate configuration UX. The dependency findings call for accepting certificate material through the API instead.

hassio.reason: Matter imports Home Assistant OS add-on lifecycle directly. Needs the portability patch that configures an external Matter Server endpoint.

humidifier.reason: Entity domain (integration_type: entity) implemented by MQTT. Substrate, not a product.

image_upload.reason: Declared dependency of person; leaves with it.

infrared.reason: Entity domain (integration_type: entity) implemented by MQTT. Substrate, not a product.

intent.reason: Declared dependency of conversation. The overview keeps conversation/intent/LLM primitives because mcp_server requires them.

lawn_mower.reason: Entity domain (integration_type: entity) implemented by MQTT. Substrate, not a product.

llm.reason: LLM API substrate behind mcp_server; entity domains expose themselves to it through llm.py.

media_source.reason: Reached from camera/media_source.py, a product adapter.

onboarding.reason: The Matter config flow reads onboarding state. Needs the same portability patch as hassio.

person.reason: Reached from zone/condition.py, a device-automation adapter.

recorder.reason: Current persistence machinery, imported by sensor/recorder.py for statistics. Its replacement is Wave 5, not a Wave 4 deletion.

scene.reason: Reached from config/scene.py, a backend config panel adapter.

stream.reason: Camera streaming infrastructure (integration_type: system), imported by camera/__init__.py at module level.

tag.reason: Entity domain (integration_type: entity) implemented by mqtt/tag.py, which turns NFC and RFID scans published over MQTT into tag events. Surfaced only after the closure learned to read 'from homeassistant.components import tag'.

weather.reason: The temperature and humidity triggers declare a DomainSpec over weather entities. No retained integration provides the weather platform, so that spec can never match in ha-lite; dropping it frees the domain. Deferred because the upstream trigger and condition tests reference weather in 99 places.

web_rtc.reason: Camera WebRTC ICE infrastructure (integration_type: system), imported by camera/__init__.py at module level.

zone.reason: Reached from device_tracker/device_trigger.py, a device-automation adapter.
